title: ZYNTINI INFLOW (Aroha Aperitivo Mix) [124]
style: Latin house meets Mediterranean nu-disco, 124 BPM, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), bilingual chop weave Spanish + te reo Maori + English, plucked nylon guitar riff, conga and bongo grooves, slap bass, brass stabs, shimmering Rhodes, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, golden-hour rooftop aperitivo energy, sidechain pumping pads on the kick, club-warmup 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(nylon guitar plucks, conga roll in)
(ZYN — TI — NI...)
(in... flow... in... flow...)
(aroha... amor... love...)

[Build]
(slap bass enters, brass stabs swell)
ZYN — TI — NI! IN — FLOW!
VAMOS! VAMOS! HAERE! HAERE!
ZYN — TI — NI! IN — FLOW!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(conga fill, riser)

[Drop 1]
(four-on-the-floor kick, slap bass groove)
IN — FLOW!
AR — O — HA!
A — MOR!
LOVE!
(female chop stack +7) si-si-si-si / ae-ae-ae-ae / yes-yes-yes-yes
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(half-time groove, chops trade left-right)
(que?) (cosa?) (now?)
(he aha?) (he aha?)
(what?) (what?) (go!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE GLASS —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to nylon guitar + Rhodes pad)
(whispered) zyn... ti... ni...
(soft) aroha... amor... love...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(brass swells back)

[Drop 2]
(brass + slap bass peak, congas double)
ZYN — TI — NI! (in-flow in-flow!)
AR — O — HA! (a-mor a-mor!)
VAMOS! HAERE! GO!
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(nylon guitar resolves, congas fade)
(zyn... ti... ni...)
(aroha... amor... love...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(guitar pluck out)
